mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 3.0% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for two consecutive months signals economic weakness that triggers equity sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS (both >0.5% MoM) fails to predict positive 20-day S&P 500 returns in more than 55% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, sustained industrial production growth signals manufacturing strength that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (GDP growth >3.0% and UNRATE <5.0%), INDPRO growth fails to predict positive 60-day S&P 500 returns in more than 55% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 3.0%, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong month-over-month non-farm payrolls growth signals economic resilience that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of strong employment growth (PAYEMS MoM >0.5%), S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 2000.0 thousand units indicate a robust housing market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 2000.0 thousand units, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarter-over-quarter growth in industrial production and real GDP indicates strong supply-side economic momentum that supports corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising INDPRO and GDPC1 (both >0.5% QoQ) fails to predict positive 60-day S&P 500 returns in more than 55% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.
